```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

source("00_setup.R")


# Assumes:
#   - Chik_total from 01_data_import_cleaning.Rmd
#   - pop_panel_total from 02_population_panel.R

STUDY_START_YEAR <- 2016L
STUDY_END_YEAR   <- 2025L
STUDY_YEARS      <- STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR

results_dir <- RESULTS_DIR
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

stopifnot(
  exists("Chik_total"),
  exists("pop_panel_total"),
  all(lubridate::year(as.Date(Chik_total$DT_SIN_PRI)) %in% STUDY_YEARS)
)
```

## SUS health-region crosswalk and adjacency graph

```{r health-region-crosswalk}
# Use the 2025 SUS health-region definition.
# This analysis is performed at health-region level because annual deaths
# are too sparse for stable municipality-level joint modeling.

health_regions_sf <- read_health_region(year = 2025, showProgress = FALSE) %>%
  st_make_valid()

muni_to_health_region <- health_regions_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  distinct(code_muni, code_health_region) %>%
  mutate(
    code_muni = str_pad(
      substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6),
      6,
      pad = "0"
    )
  )

health_region_graph_sf <- health_regions_sf %>%
  group_by(code_health_region) %>%
  summarise(.groups = "drop") %>%
  st_make_valid()

nb_hr <- poly2nb(health_region_graph_sf)

adj_file_hr <- file.path(
  results_dir,
  "health_region_graph_2025.adj"
)

nb2INLA(file = adj_file_hr, nb = nb_hr)

stopifnot(file.exists(adj_file_hr))

g_hr <- INLA::inla.read.graph(adj_file_hr)
hr_levels <- health_region_graph_sf$code_health_region

cat("Municipalities mapped:", nrow(muni_to_health_region), "\n")
cat("Health regions:", length(hr_levels), "\n")
cat("Adjacency graph nodes:", g_hr$n, "\n")

stopifnot(g_hr$n == length(hr_levels))
```

## Build health-region by year panel

```{r hr-panel}
chik_hr_base <- Chik_total %>%
  filter(
    CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13),
    !is.na(DT_SIN_PRI)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year      = as.integer(format(as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI), "%Y")),
    code_muni = str_pad(
      substr(as.character(ID_MUNICIP), 1, 6),
      6,
      pad = "0"
    ),
    is_death  = EVOLUCAO == 2
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    muni_to_health_region,
    by = "code_muni"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(code_health_region))

cases_by_hr_year <- chik_hr_base %>%
  count(
    code_health_region,
    year,
    name = "cases"
  )

deaths_by_hr_year <- chik_hr_base %>%
  filter(is_death) %>%
  count(
    code_health_region,
    year,
    name = "deaths"
  )

pop_hr_year <- pop_panel_total %>%
  mutate(
    code_muni = str_pad(
      substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6),
      6,
      pad = "0"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    muni_to_health_region,
    by = "code_muni"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(code_health_region)) %>%
  group_by(
    code_health_region,
    year
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    pop = sum(total_pop, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hr_panel <- expand.grid(
  code_health_region = hr_levels,
  year = STUDY_YEARS
) %>%
  left_join(
    cases_by_hr_year,
    by = c("code_health_region", "year")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    deaths_by_hr_year,
    by = c("code_health_region", "year")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    pop_hr_year,
    by = c("code_health_region", "year")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cases  = replace_na(cases, 0),
    deaths = replace_na(deaths, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pop),
    pop > 0
  )

cat(
  "Health-region-years in panel:",
  nrow(hr_panel),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  all(hr_panel$year %in% STUDY_YEARS)
)

summary(hr_panel$cases)
summary(hr_panel$deaths)
```

## Shared-component model function

```{r shared-component-function}
fit_shared_component_year <- function(
  year_to_fit,
  panel = hr_panel,
  graph = g_hr,
  levels = hr_levels
) {

  yr_data <- panel %>%
    filter(year == year_to_fit) %>%
    mutate(
      space_id = match(
        code_health_region,
        levels
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(space_id))

  nat_case_rate <- sum(
    yr_data$cases,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) / sum(
    yr_data$pop,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  nat_death_rate <- sum(
    yr_data$deaths,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) / sum(
    yr_data$pop,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  long_df <- bind_rows(
    yr_data %>%
      transmute(
        y = cases,
        E = pop * nat_case_rate,
        outcome = "case",
        alpha_case = 1,
        alpha_death = 0,
        id_shared_case = space_id,
        id_shared_death = NA_integer_,
        id_case_specific = space_id,
        id_death_specific = NA_integer_
      ),

    yr_data %>%
      transmute(
        y = deaths,
        E = pop * nat_death_rate,
        outcome = "death",
        alpha_case = 0,
        alpha_death = 1,
        id_shared_case = NA_integer_,
        id_shared_death = space_id,
        id_case_specific = NA_integer_,
        id_death_specific = space_id
      )
  )

  formula_shared <- y ~ 0 +
    alpha_case +
    alpha_death +

    f(
      id_shared_case,
      model = "bym2",
      graph = graph,
      scale.model = TRUE,
      hyper = list(
        prec = list(
          prior = "pc.prec",
          param = c(1, 0.01)
        ),
        phi = list(
          prior = "pc",
          param = c(0.5, 2/3)
        )
      )
    ) +

    f(
      id_shared_death,
      copy = "id_shared_case",
      fixed = FALSE,
      hyper = list(
        beta = list(
          prior = "normal",
          param = c(0, 5)
        )
      )
    ) +

    f(
      id_case_specific,
      model = "bym2",
      graph = graph,
      scale.model = TRUE,
      hyper = list(
        prec = list(
          prior = "pc.prec",
          param = c(1, 0.01)
        ),
        phi = list(
          prior = "pc",
          param = c(0.5, 2/3)
        )
      )
    ) +

    f(
      id_death_specific,
      model = "bym2",
      graph = graph,
      scale.model = TRUE,
      hyper = list(
        prec = list(
          prior = "pc.prec",
          param = c(1, 0.01)
        ),
        phi = list(
          prior = "pc",
          param = c(0.5, 2/3)
        )
      )
    )

  require_model_fitting("Module 11 shared-component model")
  fit <- inla(
    formula_shared,
    family = "poisson",
    data = long_df,
    E = long_df$E,
    control.predictor = list(
      compute = TRUE,
      link = 1
    ),
    control.compute = list(
      dic = TRUE,
      waic = TRUE,
      config = TRUE
    ),
    control.inla = list(
      strategy = "simplified.laplace"
    ),
    num.threads = "1:1",
    verbose = TRUE
  )

  fit
}
```

## Load existing yearly fits and fit only missing years

```{r shared-component-all-years}
years_to_fit <- STUDY_YEARS

shared_fits <- list()
shared_fit_failures <- character(0)
years_missing <- integer(0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load all completed yearly fits
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for (yr in years_to_fit) {

  fit_file <- file.path(
    results_dir,
    paste0("fit_shared_", yr, ".rds")
  )

  if (file.exists(fit_file)) {

    cat(
      "Loading existing fit:",
      yr,
      "from",
      fit_file,
      "\n"
    )

    loaded_fit <- tryCatch(
      readRDS(fit_file),
      error = function(e) {
        cat(
          "WARNING: could not read saved fit for",
          yr,
          ":",
          conditionMessage(e),
          "\n"
        )
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (!is.null(loaded_fit)) {
      shared_fits[[as.character(yr)]] <- loaded_fit
    } else {
      years_missing <- c(
        years_missing,
        yr
      )
    }

  } else {

    years_missing <- c(
      years_missing,
      yr
    )
  }
}

cat(
  "\nAlready available:",
  if (length(shared_fits)) {
    paste(names(shared_fits), collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    "none"
  },
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Years still needing a fit:",
  if (length(years_missing)) {
    paste(years_missing, collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    "none"
  },
  "\n"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Fit only missing or unreadable years
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for (yr in years_missing) {

  cat(
    "\n==================== Fitting year",
    yr,
    "====================\n"
  )

  fit_result <- tryCatch(
    fit_shared_component_year(yr),
    error = function(e) {
      cat(
        "FAILED for year",
        yr,
        ":",
        conditionMessage(e),
        "\n"
      )
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(fit_result)) {
    shared_fit_failures <- c(
      shared_fit_failures,
      as.character(yr)
    )
    next
  }

  fit_file <- file.path(
    results_dir,
    paste0("fit_shared_", yr, ".rds")
  )

  save_ok <- tryCatch(
    {
      saveRDS(
        fit_result,
        fit_file
      )
      TRUE
    },
    error = function(e) {
      cat(
        "WARNING: could not save fit_shared_",
        yr,
        ".rds (",
        conditionMessage(e),
        "). Fit remains in memory.\n",
        sep = ""
      )
      FALSE
    }
  )

  if (save_ok) {
    cat(
      "Saved:",
      fit_file,
      "\n"
    )
  }

  shared_fits[[as.character(yr)]] <- fit_result
}

# Chronological ordering
shared_fits <- shared_fits[
  intersect(
    as.character(years_to_fit),
    names(shared_fits)
  )
]

cat("\n=== Shared-component fit summary ===\n")

cat(
  "Years available:",
  if (length(shared_fits)) {
    paste(names(shared_fits), collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    "none"
  },
  "\n"
)

if (length(shared_fit_failures) > 0) {
  cat(
    "Years that failed during this run:",
    paste(shared_fit_failures, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )
}

missing_after_run <- setdiff(
  as.character(years_to_fit),
  names(shared_fits)
)

cat(
  "Years unavailable after this run:",
  if (length(missing_after_run)) {
    paste(missing_after_run, collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    "none"
  },
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  all(as.character(STUDY_YEARS) %in% names(shared_fits))
)
```

## Shared spatial loading over time

```{r concordance-time-series}
concordance_df <- map_dfr(
  names(shared_fits),
  function(yr) {

    fit <- shared_fits[[yr]]

    beta_row <- fit$summary.hyperpar[
      grepl(
        "^Beta for",
        rownames(fit$summary.hyperpar)
      ),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    if (nrow(beta_row) != 1) {

      warning(
        "Year ",
        yr,
        ": expected exactly one Beta row, found ",
        nrow(beta_row)
      )

      return(
        tibble(
          year = as.integer(yr),
          beta_mean = NA_real_,
          beta_lower = NA_real_,
          beta_upper = NA_real_
        )
      )
    }

    tibble(
      year = as.integer(yr),
      beta_mean = beta_row[1, "mean"],
      beta_lower = beta_row[1, "0.025quant"],
      beta_upper = beta_row[1, "0.975quant"]
    )
  }
)

concordance_df <- tibble(
  year = STUDY_YEARS
) %>%
  left_join(
    concordance_df,
    by = "year"
  ) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(
    ci_width = beta_upper - beta_lower,
    ci_includes_1 = beta_lower <= 1 & beta_upper >= 1
  )

print(concordance_df)

readr::write_csv(
  concordance_df,
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "shared_component_concordance_2016_2025.csv"
  )
)
```

## Concordance figure

```{r concordance-figure}
p_beta <- ggplot(
  concordance_df,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = beta_mean
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = beta_lower,
      ymax = beta_upper
    ),
    alpha = 0.2,
    fill = "#2c7fb8"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    color = "#2c7fb8",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2,
    color = "#2c7fb8"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = STUDY_YEARS
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Shared spatial loading of mortality relative to cases",
    subtitle = "Beta = 1 indicates equal loading on the shared spatial field",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Beta"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_beta
```

## Extract 2024 and 2025 outcome-specific spatial fields

```{r extract-outcome-specific-fields}
extract_bym2_field <- function(
  fit_obj,
  term_name,
  levels = hr_levels
) {

  fit_obj$summary.random[[term_name]] %>%
    transmute(
      space_id = ID,
      effect_mean = mean
    ) %>%
    filter(
      space_id <= length(levels)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      code_health_region = levels[space_id]
    )
}

fit_shared_2024 <- shared_fits[["2024"]]
fit_shared_2025 <- shared_fits[["2025"]]

stopifnot(
  !is.null(fit_shared_2024),
  !is.null(fit_shared_2025)
)

case_specific_2024 <- extract_bym2_field(
  fit_shared_2024,
  "id_case_specific"
)

death_specific_2024 <- extract_bym2_field(
  fit_shared_2024,
  "id_death_specific"
)

case_specific_2025 <- extract_bym2_field(
  fit_shared_2025,
  "id_case_specific"
)

death_specific_2025 <- extract_bym2_field(
  fit_shared_2025,
  "id_death_specific"
)

cat("Rows per field:\n")
cat(
  "2024 case:",
  nrow(case_specific_2024),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "2024 death:",
  nrow(death_specific_2024),

)
cat(
  "2025 case:",

  "\n"
)
cat(
```

## Outcome-specific spatial maps

```{r outcome-specific-maps}
build_outcome_map <- function(
  field_df,
  title,
  limits
) {

  map_data <- health_region_graph_sf %>%
    left_join(
      field_df,
      by = "code_health_region"
    )

  ggplot(map_data) +
    geom_sf(
      aes(fill = effect_mean),
      color = NA
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#0033FF",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#FF0000",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = limits,
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = "Outcome-specific\nspatial effect"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title
    ) +
    theme_void()
}

# Use one common scale across all four maps so visual intensity is comparable.
all_field_values <- c(
  case_specific_2024$effect_mean,
  death_specific_2024$effect_mean,
  case_specific_2025$effect_mean,
  death_specific_2025$effect_mean
)

max_abs_effect <- max(
  abs(all_field_values),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

shared_limits <- c(
  -max_abs_effect,
  max_abs_effect
)

p_case_2024 <- build_outcome_map(
  case_specific_2024,
  "Case-specific field, 2024",
  shared_limits
)

p_death_2024 <- build_outcome_map(
  death_specific_2024,
  "Death-specific field, 2024",
  shared_limits
)

p_case_2025 <- build_outcome_map(
  case_specific_2025,
  "Case-specific field, 2025",
  shared_limits
)

p_death_2025 <- build_outcome_map(
  death_specific_2025,
  "Death-specific field, 2025",
  shared_limits
)

(p_case_2024 | p_death_2024) /
  (p_case_2025 | p_death_2025)
```

## Summary of strongest outcome-specific spatial signals

```{r field-summary}
hr_names <- health_regions_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  distinct(
    code_health_region,
    name_health_region,
    code_state
  )



summarize_field <- function(
  field_df,
  year_label,
  outcome_label,
  n = 15
) {

  cat(
    "\n===",
    year_label,
    ": strongest",
    outcome_label,
    "signals ===\n"
  )

  top_regions <- field_df %>%
    left_join(
      hr_names,
      by = "code_health_region"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(effect_mean)) %>%
    select(
      code_health_region,
      name_health_region,
      code_state,
      effect_mean
    ) %>%
    slice_head(n = n)

  print(top_regions)

  cat(
    "\nRange:",
    paste(
      round(
        range(
          field_df$effect_mean,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        3
      ),
      collapse = " to "
    ),
    "\n"
  )
}


summarize_field(
  case_specific_2024,
  2024,
  "case-specific"
)

summarize_field(
  death_specific_2024,
  2024,
  "death-specific"
)

summarize_field(
  case_specific_2025,
  2025,
  "case-specific"
)

summarize_field(
  death_specific_2025,
  2025,
  "death-specific"
)


```
